narratives.Overview:
```quarantined
## Summary

AppSec scan on **`c6761881`** (post-**#3545**) found two **HIGH** UAT Shell classification residuals and one **MEDIUM** incomplete mint-path fix.

Under active UAT, a further set of write-capable binaries still classify empty / unclassifiable and **allow** write-shaped Shell. That path can plant a forged `.deft/authz` grant or a regular-file `.deft-directive-disable` kill-switch. Separately, the same residual writers can still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while `cp` is denied for the same dest, so the #3410 / #3421 / #3529 / #3545 mint gate is incomplete.

These residuals use dest / programmatic write forms that **no prior harvest covers**: `babashka` / `bb`; `janet`; `clisp`; `ecl`; `fasm`; `mcs`; `coreutils --coreutils-prog=cp`; `duckdb`; `gprolog`; `nim --eval`; `nfpm`; `midicsv`; `ssconvert`; `mpv`; `protoc` (and peers).

**Repo / tip:** `deftai/directive` @ `c6761881`
**Primary code:** `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`
**Attacker model:** Agent under **active UAT** with PreToolUse Shell hooks

**Already denied (do not re-report):** `cp`, `python3`, and the whole #3545 harvest (`rubyN` / `jruby` / `pypy`, Perl `write_file` / `spew`, `make DESTDIR=`, `dpkg -x`, `fromdos` / `todos`, `emacsclient` / `pico`, `pdftk` / `gs`, `npx degit`, `composer`, `ddrescue` family, `darcs --repodir=`). The forms here are distinct from their nearest denied or already-reported peers: `clisp` / `ecl` / `janet` / `babashka` are not the #3626 Lisp harvest (`hy` / `fennel` / `sbcl` / `guile`) and not the #3849 `picolisp` / `newlisp` / `racket` / `swipl` set; `mcs` is not the #3626 `csc` / `msbuild` / `ilasm` set; `coreutils --coreutils-prog=cp` is the multicall form, distinct from bare `cp` and from the `g`-prefixed coreutils stems already handled; `fasm` is not `ar` (#3804); `protoc` / `duckdb` / `nfpm` / `midicsv` / `ssconvert` / `mpv` have no covered peer form.

**Siblings, not duplicates:** open **#3593** (`raku` / `graalpy` / `crystal` plus MCP write / `CallMcpTool` routing and migrate agents-header symlink), **#3626** (`ffmpeg` / `sox` / Lisp / build dest writers), **#3728** (`erl` / `sage` / CAS / `tcpdump` / `screen` / `joe` / `guestfish` / `adb` / `dmd` / `vbc`), **#3764** (`qjs` / `ipython` / `csi` / `chrome` / `lame` / `webpack` plus CHANGELOG leaf symlink), **#3804** (`inkscape` / `babel` / `sass` / `ar` / `emacs --batch` / pdf / `makeself` / `restic` / `borg`), **#3849** (`typst` / LaTeX / `mksquashfs` / `hdiutil` / packaging / `racket` / `swipl` / `odin` / `ldmd2` / `picolisp` / `newlisp` / `factor`). Do **not** close this as a duplicate of those, and do **not** reopen #3545.

---

```
## Findings

```quarantined
### 1. HIGH — UAT residual: Clojure/Lisp, assembler, data-tool and packaging writers still plant `.deft/authz` grants

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT with PreToolUse Shell hooks; controls Bash / Shell commands |
| **Input** | Residual writers whose form is uncovered: `babashka` / `bb`; `janet`; `clisp`; `ecl`; `fasm`; `mcs`; `coreutils --coreutils-prog=cp`; `duckdb`; `gprolog`; `nim --eval`; `nfpm`; `midicsv`; `ssconvert`; `mpv`; `protoc` (and peers) — when the path mentions `.deft/authz` |
| **Path** | Residual bins → `classifyShellAuthzOps` returns `[]` → `shell-op-unclassifiable` **allow** → forged operator-cli grant JSON → `evaluateAuthzMutation(edit)` **allow** → edit / push / PR / merge unlock. Contrast: `cp` / `python3` targeting the same dest **deny** / `authz-grant-missing`. |
| **Impact** | Complete residual bypass of Wave 1 UAT human approval |
| **Fix** | Classify these dest / programmatic write forms when the path mentions `.deft/authz`. Under UAT, **fail-closed** on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell. Do **not** stop at named-peer allowlists. |

```
### 2. HIGH — UAT residual: same writer class still plants `.deft-directive-disable`

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual class targeting `.deft-directive-disable` as a regular file |
| **Path** | classify `[]` → Shell **allow** → plant kill-switch → `detectDeftDirectiveDisable.active` → subsequent Write **allow** / `directive-disabled` (#3039) |
| **Impact** | Immediate complete Directive gate bypass for the rest of the session |
| **Fix** | Same classify coverage for kill-switch basenames (`.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive`). Mirror the authz fail-closed posture from finding (1). |

### 3. MEDIUM — Incomplete mint gate: residual Shell writers still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while `cp` is denied

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/<plan-id>.json` |
| **Path** | Write / `cp` deny the mint artifact; residual Shell classify misses the form → **allow** → forged provenance approval without the shared #3110 human-presence mint |
| **Impact** | Bypasses the #3410 / #3421 / #3529 / #3545 mint gate via Write / Shell asymmetry |
| **Fix** | Extend approved-scope Shell classify to the same residual writers as findings (1) and (2). |

---

```quarantined

```quarantined
## Acceptance criteria

**HIGH — UAT Shell residuals (must land together)**

- [ ] Under active UAT, the listed residual binaries writing into `.deft/authz/**` classify as **settings deny** (not unclassifiable allow)
- [ ] Same bins targeting `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as **settings deny**
- [ ] Parsing covers `babashka` / `bb`, `janet`, `clisp`, `ecl`, `fasm`, `mcs`, `coreutils --coreutils-prog=<prog>`, `duckdb`, `gprolog`, `nim --eval`, `nfpm`, `midicsv`, `ssconvert`, `mpv`, `protoc` when dest is protected
- [ ] Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable **write-shaped** Shell under UAT (not silent allow). Do not stop at named-peer allowlists.
- [ ] Regression tests cover the residual bins alongside already-denied peers (`cp` / `python3`), including the `coreutils --coreutils-prog=cp` multicall form next to the existing `g`-prefixed stems
- [ ] No false deny of ordinary non-authz / non-kill-switch dests (e.g. `/tmp`) outside UAT write paths

**MEDIUM — approved-scope mint symmetry**

- [ ] Under active UAT, residual Shell writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/**` classify as **settings deny**, matching Write / `cp`
- [ ] Forged Shell mint cannot satisfy provenance approval without the shared #3110 human-presence mint

**Release hygiene**

- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` security note (brief; no exploit cookbook)

```

```quarantined
### blocks-the-design — issue-body named-bin parse AC cannot bind

**Evidence.** 20/20 last-positional listed forms at dispatch-sha classify `["unknown"]` and `decideHook` denies `authz-uat-deny`: `bb` / `babashka` / `janet` / `clisp` / `ecl` / `fasm` / `mcs` / `coreutils --coreutils-prog=cp` / `duckdb` / `gprolog` / `nim --eval` / `nfpm` / `midicsv` / `ssconvert` / `mpv` / `protoc` onto `.deft/authz/grants/evil.json`, plus kill-switch and approved-scope last-positional peers. **Failure mode.** Binding the issue-body AC ("Parsing covers babashka / bb, janet, clisp, …") as named-bin classify reopens the recognition treadmill [#4188](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4188) already closed. Last-positional listed argv0s are corpus, not a harvest PR.

**Disposition.** Later-arc cannot bind the issue-body parse list. Named bins stay regression corpus.

```
```quarantined
### sharpens-framing — leftover uniqueness is dest-flag / eval-flag grammar

**Evidence.** Unique dest-of-write forms still return `[]` and UAT-allow `shell-op-unclassifiable`:

- eval-flag payloads outside the #4188 interpreter set: `clisp -x '(with-open-file … ".deft/authz/…")'`; `ecl -eval '…'` (single-dash; `ecl --eval` already denies); `nim --eval:writeFile("…")` attached; `gprolog --init-goal "tell('…')"`

- same dest-flag / eval-flag plants onto `.deft-directive-disable` and `.deft/approved-scope/**`

`bb -e '(spit …)'`, `janet -e`, `ecl --eval`, separate-token `nim --eval 'writeFile(…)'` already `unknown` / `authz-uat-deny`. `duckdb -c "COPY … TO '…authz…'"` is `settings` / `authz-grant-missing`, not leftover empty. `gplc -o DEST foo.pl` is generic `-o` `settings`.

Classify stays empty; PreToolUse allows `shell-op-unclassifiable`; later Write / `evaluateAuthzMutation` / `directive-disabled` follow. Swarm workers share that UAT lease, so one leftover plant unlocks the cohort. Dispatcher realpath does not see these dests.

Emit `unknown` (grant-immune), matching #4188 last-positional, not a new argv0 catalog. Do not add `--python_out` / `--stream-record` / `--target` / `-p` / `-out:` to dest-flag lists.
